they are present at this meeting via zoom and at the table or myself and councilman Esquibel and with that I will ask the clerk to please read the first item number 13 ordinance second reading finance committee members Brad Brooks uh city of Cheyenne Board of Public Utilities director uh we'll have before you today is as was explained an amendment to ordinance 4447 this is the ordinance that approved all of our rates fees for this fiscal year um as you know a lot of those rates and fees don't take effect till January 1st as we were getting ready to put that information together to get it out for notices it'll be effective this coming January we happen to notice that on item nine in that resolution which basically covers its resolution 2022 shows three um which has our revised water sewer connection fees system development fees Pump Station fees development fees and related fees set forth by the board we noticed an item uh in in that resolution's item Roman numeral one and two were actually left out so when we went to convert them over to send them over to the city they were approved by our board but one and two which covered the water connections fees for anything from actually worked through Stephanie Chris and Kylie and they were all a big help what would be the best plan of attack to how to correct this bring it back before Council and so we figured just we would just amend the ordinance and replace or the resolution 202203 in its entirety so what you have here is a new resolution 03 which has been stamped by our 10th attorney and also signed by Mary Gus be record and uh also please make sure your cell phones are either on vibrate or mute and uh with that I'll have the clerk read the first item on the agenda please number 23 resolution authorizing submission of an application to the Wyoming water development commission for grant funding for the boring well-field Expansion Project in the amount of 7 million thirty five thousand dollars and authorizing the director of the Board of Public Utilities to execute the application and all related documents Brooks yes good morning Mr chair and finance committee members um yes what you have before you is a a resolution authorizing submission of the grant to wwcc um we actually attended a meeting last week with them and at that meeting they did announce that they're not going to recommend several projects ours being won just because of lack of funds so uh there is some other Grant options for us that we're probably going to go after through the well drilling to keep the this is the first part of the Belvoir to keep that going they have a four a grant program that they'll award up to 400 000. it's probably going to cost around a million dollars to drill those too well so the board will have some out of expense uh funds that we'll need to do but at least keep the project going and get that 400 000 from the water development commission and then we'll probably go back to them in a year and do the actual remainder of the project and see if that will look more favorable favorable in their program so um I guess just bring for you today there's probably no reason to take item 23 onto the governing body uh since we were not recommended last week for funding so thanks for the information any questions you may have thank you Mr Brooks uh comments from the public is there [VERBATIM BROADCAST TRANSCRIPT — Work Session 09-29-22]

Context/Agenda: # Work Session 09-29-22

Context/Agenda: okay Jennifer your everything's good all right awesome okay everybody thank you for coming to the city of Cheyenne city council work session for September 30th uh 2022 the topic of conversation is outside water use agreements as with all work sessions there is no public comment uh to my right I have councilman layborn and myself and uh several of our council members are currently not present that they will be listening in later and for all of the council members that are going to reply uh via Zoom for questions for the Board of Public Utilities if you could please do use the raise hand feature so Jennifer knows uh who to announce and uh your order of the questions that will be taken uh because I've already instructed the room uh which is not very many people to turn off their cell phones or either put them on mute anybody that is in Zoom land if you could please mute yourself so that there's no outside interference and so with that I will go ahead and turn this meeting over to to Brad Brooks of the Board of Public Utilities I've already discussed with Brad earlier today that questions can come throughout the debate instead of waiting at the end so I will go ahead and turn this over to Brad at this time yes thank you Mr chair again and fellow council members or council members mayor we appreciate the opportunity coming for you today as was mentioned by councilman Johnson we are going to kind of just give an overview of how we process outside user agreements we do have an agenda before us what I thought in in talking with councilman Johnson earlier that maybe we would as we finished each numeral or numeric item there maybe we could open it up at that time for any specific questions and just keep going through the agenda with me today I will add I have with us Frank strong who is our engineering and water resources manager I Have Bryce door who is our Capital project supervisor and then Linda Gunther to my left who's our development specialist and these three individuals on a day in day out basis they're the ones that deal with these uh outside user agreements continually they're the ones that are dealing with the applicants that are coming in so I brought them because they're going to do a majority of the talking um with that um just to share with with Council we do have a procedure that we follow um so when anytime somebody comes to us for an outside user agreement there is a a procedure we have that available I can get that to council members if they would like but basically there's just a few areas there's the initial customer contact where they come to us and are requesting an outside user agreement we kind of question what are they what are they needing for getting some of the particulars then basically once we get past that point we actually provide the customer with the application there is an application fee that's paid to the Board of Public Utilities for processing that outside user agreement and then we actually also ask for a clearance form from the development office as part of that package that is something I'd like to

Context/Agenda: # Work Session - Zoning Code Enforcement/Annexation 06-24-22

Context/Agenda: fucking hmm recording in progress okay let's go ahead and bring this uh this work session in order my understanding is it's uh the first part is going to be about a zoning code enforcement text amendment and then some talked about annexation of county pockets all right let's get this party started good afternoon members of city council connor white uh planning and development department so what i'm here to talk to all of you about uh is a proposed text amendment to our unified development code for enforcing of our zoning code um i'll start out with kind of just briefly of how our process currently works and why we're looking at doing this amendment and then what the major kind of sections in this new amendment are and how it will help us enforce the zoning code going forward so currently with our process um with our last budget we did um council did approve a new position basically with our co-enforcement officer that we have who does most of our zoning code enforcement and then i act as that liaison kind of with knowing the udc inside and out so what we do with our code enforcement right now we basically act on anything that comes in with our complaint form or phone calls or now that we have a code enforcement officer if he sees anything that's obviously just obvious out in the field that is a zoning violation we'll start enforcement action on those process right now is a first notice which is then gives the person who's in violation 20 days to remedy that issue um and then if nothing is done in 20 days there's a final notice
